description: Fetch a single active job's summary by id (no full description). Region-locked jobs are withheld by default, same as search_jobs.

include_region_locked.description: Default false. When true, return the job even if it is region-locked away from Indonesia; read `indonesiaEligibility` on the result.

job_id.description: Job id from a search_jobs result.
